prompt:
A wide picture for a 2D game, piece ella-attack. Ella shooting: four poses in a row, side view, the umbrella held level like a lance, build, release, a gold pulse leaving the tip, recovery. Ella is an adult with dark brown hair, a hat, a cloth mask hiding her face, a scarf, boots, holding a black umbrella with light stripes with two hands. The background is one perfectly flat, even, pure green #00FF00 from edge to edge, the shapes cut cleanly against it, and the shapes use no green. The canvas holds only the subject floating on the green, nothing else, no text. 

Style (required): dark, muted ink on aged paper, like an etched storybook engraving. Etched ink linework with near-black ink outlines; crosshatch and fine line hatching for every shadow and form; visible aged paper grain and fibre texture under all colour; hand-printed, slightly uneven ink. No flat fills, no vector shapes, no smooth digital gradients, no glossy 3D rendering.
